summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) filed a Form 6-K furnishing minutes of an August 25, 2026 Board of Directors meeting. The board acknowledged the resignation of a Remuneration Committee member, elected a replacement subject to Central Bank of Brazil approval, and ratified the committee's composition. This is a routine governance matter with no transactional elements, deal terms, or strategic implications. It does not constitute a special situation under any defined category, as it involves standard committee succession and regulatory approval procedures common to financial institutions.
